verdict.rationale: Attio ships an official, richly documented App SDK in TypeScript/React. It covers extensions, pages, workflow blocks, server functions that call the REST API, a GraphQL data API, connections and webhook handlers. Attio says it was "designed from the ground up to enable AI-assisted development", and new apps come bootstrapped with AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files. However, it is scoped to apps running inside Attio's infrastructure, and the evidence shows no general-purpose official REST client libraries; only a public OpenAPI spec is documented, which is a building block for generating clients rather than an SDK. Missing for 10: official standalone API client SDKs (e.g., Node/Python) for external integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
